summary: AutoZone filed an 8-K announcing its Board authorized an additional $1.5 billion in share repurchases under its ongoing buyback program, bringing total authorizations to $42.2 billion since 1998. No price per share or specific premium is given, as this is an open-market authorization. The program is discretionary and will be funded from free cash flow while maintaining credit ratings. No board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock applies. Watch for execution pace and potential impact on EPS, though no risk-arb angle exists as this is not a tender offer.
